mapper.sql: from ar_scene s where s.enabled and s.deleted_at is null and exists(select 1 from ar_scene_file f where f.scene_id = s.id) and not exists(select 1 from ar_scene_file f where f.scene_id = s.id and f.status <> 'AVAILABLE') and not exists(select 1 from ar_scene_deletion d where d.scene_id = s.id and d.completed_at is null)
mapper.select: select count(*) and position(lower(#{name}) in lower(s.name)) > 0

select s.id::text as id, s.name
and s.id = cast(#{sceneId} as uuid)
select id::text as id, relative_path, expected_bytes, expected_sha256 from ar_scene_file where scene_id = cast(#{sceneId} as uuid) order by relative_path, id
